924fc966-a8f5-4288-82f2-6b9224819ccd.comment: Validates input 1 produces 0 factors. In C, find_factors(1, buf) skips even division (1 % 2 != 0) and trial division (i = 3 > sqrt(1)). The boundary check (n > 2) is false, returning size_t count 0 without accessing or populating the factors array buffer.

17e30670-b105-4305-af53-ddde182cb6ad.comment: Validates smallest prime 2. In C, handled via the initial while ((n % 2 == 0) && (count < MAXFACTORS)) reduction loop and integer division n /= 2, storing 2 at factors[0] and returning count 1.

238d57c8-4c12-42ef-af34-ae4929f94789.comment: Validates odd prime 3. In C, skips even division, bypasses the for loop trial division because initial i = 3 > floor(sqrt(3)) = 1, and is captured by the remainder check if (n > 2) which sets factors[0] = 3 and returns count 1.
